architecture_summary: Modular React app. Static pages mirror Stitch screens. Shared components extracted from duolingo_card_components_showcase. Router use React Router. CSS use Tailwind. No state management (Redux/Yjs) yet. Data hardcoded. API stubs for later.

tickets.title: Extract shared card components from duolingo_card_components_showcase
tickets.description: Identify reusable card components (achievement, course, leaderboard, etc). Create src/components/cards/. Each component accept props for dynamic content. Style match Stitch exactly. Use Tailwind classes. No logic. Pure presentational.
acceptance_criteria: Each card render correctly with sample data

tickets.title: Build landing page (duolingo_landing_page + variants)
tickets.description: Combine all landing variants into single src/pages/Landing.jsx. Use conditional rendering for hero/social-proof/feature sections. Hardcode data. Reuse card components where applicable. Style match Stitch exactly. Mobile responsive via Tailwind.

tickets.title: Build learning dashboard (duolingo_learning_dashboard)
tickets.description: Create src/pages/Dashboard.jsx. Layout match Stitch. Reuse card components. Hardcode user data (streak, XP, etc). Style match exactly. Mobile responsive.

tickets.title: Build learning table (duolingo_learning_table)
tickets.description: Create src/pages/LearningTable.jsx. Table layout match Stitch. Hardcode lesson data. Style match exactly. Mobile responsive via Tailwind.

tickets.title: Build profile page (duolingo_profile_page)
tickets.description: Create src/pages/Profile.jsx. Layout match Stitch. Hardcode user profile data. Reuse card components. Style match exactly. Mobile responsive.

tickets.title: Build pricing page (duolingo_pricing_page)
tickets.description: Create src/pages/Pricing.jsx. Layout match Stitch. Hardcode pricing tiers. Style match exactly. Mobile responsive.

tickets.title: Build style guide page (duolingo_style_guide_page)
tickets.description: Create src/pages/StyleGuide.jsx. Document all design tokens (colors, typography, spacing). Match Stitch exactly. Mobile responsive.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create src/App.jsx. Set up React Router with routes for all pages. Navigation bar match Stitch. Mobile responsive. Dark mode toggle (hardcoded state). Error boundary for 404.
